title: Sync sheet & cut-criteria framework for API/Console/Runtime release
creator: Diego Martinez
description: Create a single-source-of-truth sync sheet and decision framework that defines milestone gating, scope-lock rules, and cut criteria for the combined API / Console / Runtime release. This ticket coordinates who publishes release notes, owners for each feature/product area, cross-team go-to-market tasks (docs, marketing assets, support runbooks), and a lightweight escalation path for last-minute quality regressions. Deliverables: 1) canonical sync sheet (CSV/Drive), 2) cut-criteria checklist with acceptance examples, 3) release notes owner matrix and template, 4) kickoff notes and communication calendar.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical sync sheet exists in Drive with read/write access to PM/ENG/Design/Docs leads
Cut criteria checklist (pass/fail with examples) approved by ENG, PM, and QA
Release notes owner matrix assigned for each feature and verified with owners
GTM tasks and owners (docs, marketing, support) are listed with due dates
A communication calendar and single release coordinator are named
progress_updates: 2026-02-19: Initial draft of sync sheet created and shared with ENG leads (link in artifacts)
2026-02-25: Engineering reviewed cut criteria; request to add KV-cache perf regression clause
2026-03-02: Docs and Support leads assigned release-notes owners per feature; merged into sheet
2026-03-08: PM/Design provided feedback on public-facing changelog phrasing; updated template
2026-03-10: Spike to validate rollback plan for runtime kernel fallback completed; added as gating item
decisions: Scope lock date set to 2026-03-18 23:59 UTC; only P0 regressions or security fixes allowed after
Cut criteria includes: automated e2e pass rate >= 98% on canary, no high-severity regressions in last 72 hours, and perf SLOs for p95 token latency within 15% of baseline
Release notes will be split into: user-facing highlights (Console/API)</>, technical changelog (Runtime) and breaking-changes section
Single release coordinator: Lina Chen (PM) — she will own day-of launch communications and final sign-off
reviewers_feedback: @eng-leads: add explicit verification steps for KV cache warming and prefix caching
@security: no outstanding cert issues; recommend a pre-release KMS key rotation test
@docs: request examples for structured output changes and sample API snippets
@support: ask for a prioritized list of customer-impacting tickets to pre-seed triage playbook
release_notes_plan: Use the release notes template in Drive; owners fill their section and mark 'ready for copy' by 2026-03-15. Docs to produce both short marketing blurb and longer technical notes. Translate high-impact user-facing notes for EU customers.
rollout_steps: T-minus 7 days: Finalize sync sheet and freeze non-P0 features
T-minus 3 days: Dry-run rollback and canary validation; publish internal readiness summary
T-minus 24 hours: Release coordinator confirms all owners have filled release notes and GTM checkboxes
Day 0: Deploy canary -> validate e2e + perf SLOs -> promote to production if green
Day 0 Post-deploy +2h: Run smoke checklist; publish public release notes and mark release as 'live'
Day 0 Post-deploy +24h: Cross-team retrospective and incident review if any regressions
notes: Trade-off: allowing minor non-customer-facing console UI tweaks after scope lock to avoid blocking runtime perf fixes
Fallback policy: if runtime p95 regression >25% post-canary, automatic rollback to previous runtime build and hold promotion
We will run a targeted customer advisory for top 15 enterprise customers 48 hours before GA
Follow-up: schedule a post-release 'what-we-learned' doc within 7 days
